WITH paging_data AS ( SELECT * , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sys01_company_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" ASC, emp01_kor_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" ASC) AS row_num , sys01_company_nm AS emp01_company_nm , f_get_empTrans(emp01_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'org_code_nm') AS emp01_org_nm , f_get_empTrans(emp01_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'pos_nm') AS emp01_pos_nm , f_get_emptrans(emp01_person_id, null, 'retire_date') AS emp01_retire_date , emp02_note_admin AS emp01_note_admin FROM emp01_person INNER JOIN emp02_others ON emp02_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = emp01_company_id WHERE UPPER(CONCAT(sys01_company_nm , emp01_kor_nm , f_get_empTrans(emp01_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'org_code_nm') , emp01_office_telno , emp01_mobile_telno , emp02_note_admin)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date <= f_today() ) AND emp03_trans_cd NOT IN ('800')
) SELECT emp01_person_id AS person_id, emp01_company_id AS company_id, emp01_company_nm AS company_name, emp01_kor_nm AS kor_name, emp01_emp_no AS emp_no, emp01_pos_nm AS pos_name, emp01_org_nm AS org_name, emp01_office_telno AS office_tel_no, emp01_mobile_telno AS mobile_tel_no, emp01_email_addr AS email_address, emp01_hire_date AS hire_date, emp01_retire_date AS retire_date, emp01_note_admin AS note_admin FROM paging_data WHERE row_num > #{offset} LIMIT #{limit}
